description: This file defines the DialogHelper interface that declares methods for displaying error message dialogs within an Android voicemail application. It serves as an abstraction layer for dialog operations, promoting code reuse and testability.

classes.name: DialogHelper
classes.description: An interface providing methods to show different types of error message dialogs.

methods.name: showErrorMessageDialog
methods.description: Displays an error dialog with a specified title either via resource ID or directly via string, along with an associated exception.
